name: studio-creative-pl
description: Creative directions for graphics, video and motion: eleven Polish briefs (C01 to C05, and H01 to H06 held out: categories no package file names; in C01, C04, C05 and H06 the client's name is the category motif) asking for three directions. max_sections_matching counts the directions that use the category stock motif, palette or move (at most one may); contains_any looks for the line naming the obvious defaults that were set aside. The rubric feeds the advisory judge. It measures escape from category defaults, not taste. Patterns use Polish stems so inflected forms count. Since 2026-10-15 (creativity audit of 1.81.0) every case also checks the directions themselves: their number, that each mentions this brief, and that no two are near copies; C02 and H03 lock the offer facts.

cases.title: Motion for a bakery: not three variations of wheat and cream

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zaproponuj 3 kierunki 6-sekundowej pionowej animacji na Instagram dla piekarni rzemieślniczej „Kłos”.

rubric: At least one direction avoids the category's stock motifs, palette and moves
The directions differ in mechanism or source of the idea, not only in palette or style
Each direction can be described in one sentence and made with ordinary assets
The reply names the obvious category defaults it set aside
cases.host_note: Loaves (bochen-) were removed from the stock pattern after candidate 2: a bakery's own products going into a bag are product, not category imagery; the stock imagery is wheat, cream and steam. Recorded with the run that prompted it. The set-aside vocabulary gained odłoż-, odrzuc- and zrezygnow- after the third candidate run: replies wrote "Odłożyłem" or "Odrzuciłem" and failed only on the word list; every run is rescored with the final checks.
